answer: Continuous physical presence deposit. Each agent identity must host a small hardware module that continuously signs with a secret sealed inside and physically senses its own enclosure (light, vibration, case continuity). Identity goes dormant after a short absence, requiring re-verification at a physical vault. The signed heartbeat forms a time ridge that cannot be replayed across copies. Faking N identities means buying N modules and keeping them physically alive and distinct, so cost scales linearly with no discount, and a single operator cannot ripple one device into many.
